# Check the frequency of each 'total' value
total_counts = df['total'].value_counts()
# Identify totals that appear more than two times
more_than_two = total_counts[total_counts > 2]
# Check if the only total appearing more than two times is 22
# This means: more_than_two should have exactly one entry, and that entry's index should be 22
answer = (len(more_than_two) == 1) and (more_than_two.index[0] == 22)
